offering_description.value: Supplies treated drinking water and provides wastewater collection and treatment for households, businesses and public customers through local utility systems. It also operates water and wastewater systems under contract and offers water and sewer service line protection plans.

primary_services.value: Water distribution; wastewater collection and treatment; fire protection water service; contract utility operations; water and sewer service line protection

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households and homeowners; B2B: Commercial and industrial properties, developers and other utilities; B2G: Municipalities and other public agencies

end_markets.value: Residential properties; commercial and industrial properties; municipal utilities; real estate development

revenue_model.value: product sales: Metered drinking water billed at utility rates; service fees: Water connection and availability, wastewater collection and treatment, and fire protection service; project or contract: Operation and maintenance of water and wastewater systems for other system owners; subscription: Recurring payments for water and sewer service line repair coverage
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract; subscription

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Treats source water and collects wastewater through utility networks serving households, businesses and public agencies; service provider: Operates client-owned utility systems and provides service line repair coverage to property owners

geography_served.value: US regional: Primarily Delaware, with water service in parts of Maryland and Pennsylvania

specialization.value: related lines: Drinking water utilities, wastewater utilities, contract utility operations and service line protection

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Utility accounts for connected properties, contracts with system owners and direct enrollment in protection plans

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State utility commissions oversee rates and service territories, and environmental agencies enforce drinking water and wastewater standards.

notes: The current footprint of its smaller utility and contract operations is uncertain.
